newsitem.title: USA: U.S. debt futures end near session high after FOMC.
newsitem.headline: U.S. debt futures end near session high after FOMC.

text.p: July 2 - U.S. debt futures ended moderately higher and near the day's high of 112-04 in Sept bonds in a subdued response to the FOMC's decision to leave short-term interest rates unchanged. Most traders had anticipated the steady policy. Dec Eurodollars posted a slight gain. Focus now turns to Thursday U.S. June employment data, with payrolls seen up 222,000.
